auto.label: Auto
auto.desc: Matches a rule — files it right away. If nothing matches, falls back to the default behavior.

hint.label: Hint
hint.desc: Shows where the bookmark will go and lets you change the folder before saving.

off.label: Off
off.desc: Regular browser bookmarks — the extension doesn't interfere.

mainTab.lead: Determines what happens when you add a bookmark. Change it here or right in the popup.

rulesTab.lead: Checked top to bottom — the first match wins.

aliasesTab.lead: Domain aliases, extraction variables, and backups.

aliasesSection.title: Domain aliases
aliasesSection.desc: One alias for multiple domains — e.g. regional mirrors.

variablesSection.title: Variables
variablesSection.desc: Alias fields for paths in the page's HTML tree. Used in rules and export.

exportSection.title: Export / Import
exportSection.desc: A single-file backup of all rules, aliases, and variables.
